title: [BUG] Claude decided to think for a very long time and then spit out what appears to be an error that claude code itself was encountering.
body:
## Environment
- Platform (select one):
Anthropic API

Claude CLI version: 0.2.67 (Claude Code)
Operating System: Windows 11, WSL - Ubuntu

## Bug Description
I have no idea what caused this, but random error after giving a command and claude code thinking for a very long time - none of this appears to have to do with my project, but with what I assume is claude code error output:

  class GroupView(BaseView):
      required_scope = "event:read"

  def _get_group_environment(self, request, group, **kwargs):
      environment_id = kwargs.get("environment_id")

      if environment_id is None:
          return Environment.get_for_organization_id(
              organization_id=group.project.organization_id
          ).first()

      return Environment.objects.get(
          organization_id=group.project.organization_id, id=environment_id

  def get(self, request, organization_slug, project_id, short_id, **kwargs):
      # TODO(dcramer): consider moving all this logic into the API
      error = render_to_response("sentry/404.html", request=request)
      try:
          # First look to see if there's a direct mapping from Group to short ID
          # (exists for all new groups)
          group = Group.objects.get(
              project__organization=Organization.objects.get_from_cache(slug=organization_slug),
              project__slug=project_id,
              short_id=short_id,
              status=GroupStatus.UNRESOLVED,
          )
      except Group.DoesNotExist:
          # If Group was created before short_id was added (or had an empty short_id)
          # then try to look up Group by its qualified (org-slug, project-slug, id) ID.
          # Note that we need to look up in GroupMeta, since a Group's short_id
          # can change over time (e.g. when renumbering)
          group_identifier = f"o:{organization_slug},p:{project_id},i:{short_id}"
          try:
              group_meta = GroupMeta.objects.get(
                  key="fingerprint",
                  value=md5_text(group_identifier).hexdigest(),
              )
          except GroupMeta.DoesNotExist:
              # If for some reason the GroupMeta doesn't exist (e.g. group was deleted)
              # then just return the 404 page
              return error

          try:
              group = Group.objects.get(id=group_meta.group_id, status=GroupStatus.UNRESOLVED)
          except Group.DoesNotExist:
              # If for some reason the Group doesn't exist (e.g. deleted)
              # then just return the 404 page
              return error
